candidateTurns.text: I can't start the simulation software. A message says all the floating licenses are in use.
Two computers in the training room may still be holding licenses from yesterday's class.

If that doesn't free a license, can I use the trial version?
It doesn't support our model size. Let me resolve the license issue, and I'll message you when a seat becomes available.
